title: Lazar's account to Vallee of a drink causing memory lapses
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lazar's account to Vallee of a drink causing memory lapses, about 1989-1990s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and ask him what he meant when he told Jacques Vallee about the liquid he was made to drink and the memory lapses it caused and about his relationship with John Lear.
he wrote a book called Messengers of Deception and he writes about you
tellings.difference: Names Vallee's book, Messengers of Deception, as where he wrote about Lazar.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Vallee's account of the drink Lazar was made to take and the memory lapses it caused.

as_told.title: Vallee's Messengers of Deception on Lazar's drink

related.note: This is the same drink Lazar says he was given at S-4. The stored story has him telling Vallee it caused memory lapses, while here it is an immune booster given after an allergen test.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on alien spacecraft at a secret Nevada site called S-4 near the Area 51 air base, once told the UFO researcher Jacques Vallee that he was made to drink a liquid there that caused gaps in his memory. Michels says Vallee wrote about Lazar in his book Messengers of Deception, and he also asks about Lazar's ties to John Lear, another figure in UFO circles. If true, it would suggest the workers at the site had their memories deliberately tampered with.
